notes.title: 🎉 Patch 1.0.8 is Live! | Localization, Fixes & Steam Upgrades
notes.content:
[h2]📢 Full Patch Notes – Version 1.0.8[/h2]

Hey everyone!

We’ve just released Patch 1.0.8, and it’s packed with quality-of-life improvements, new language localizations, and a few visual tweaks! Here’s what’s new:

[h2]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Resolved several user-reported bugs 🐛
[*] Enhanced Steam integration for smoother platform features 🎮
[/list]

[h2]🌍 New Localization Support[/h2]

[list]
[*] 🇯🇵 Japanese
[*] 🇨🇳 Chinese (Simplified)
[*] 🇰🇷 Korean
[/list]

Your feedback helped make this happen — thank you! 🙌

[h2]✨ Visual Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Minor VFX adjustments in the Sea of Simulation area 🌊
[/list]

We're continuing to work on future updates, so if you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please let us know either on Steam, YT, Instagram or X

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417373/0e3b996170e71d56e8a45aff5ac1a2ec8f09bc3f.png[/img]

Thank you for playing and supporting our game! 💖

– MudPie Studio

notes.title: 🎉 Gloom - System Breach is Out Now! 🎉
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Gloom - System Breach has officially launched! Version 1.0.7 is now available for purchase on Steam!

This full release marks the beginning of your deep dive into a cyber-infused world filled with dangerous enemies, electronic puzzles, and moments that will keep you on edge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417373/b4bc1af4f1d64b5d34f93f774b20d8f3848bc1b9.png[/img]

[h3]🆕 Demo Updated![/h3]
The demo has also been updated to version 1.0.7 — now running on the same core as the full game, with limited content to give you a taste of the full experience.

[h2]🔧 Key Features[/h2]

🎮 Full controller support
🌍 Available in 7 languages:

[list]
[*] English
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] German
[*] Spanish (Spain)
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese (Portugal)
[/list]

⚙️ Supports DLSS and FSR for enhanced performance

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417373/38644a2fa6badfcd8dd60fef1db00b9c676383ff.png[/img]

Get ready to face a wide variety of enemies, crack electronic security systems, and experience moments that challenge both your reflexes and your mind.

[h3]🛠 Ongoing Support[/h3]
We’ll be actively supporting Gloom - System Breach over the coming weeks and addressing any technical issues that arise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417373/bb12e945df266d54ecfb588e56ff5dfeac369c07.png[/img]

The game includes a built-in bug reporting system, which is the fastest way for us to know if something isn't working as it should. It works automatically and you do not have to report it manually.

If you’d prefer to reach out directly, you can also contact us via email:
📧 mudpie.std@gmail.com

Thanks for playing — and stay sharp out there.

➡️ Dive in now and breach the system.

notes.title: Gloom - System Breach demo v. 1.0.6 is live! New level, new enemies and more.
notes.content:
[h2]Next Steam Fest[/h2]
Within this new version of demo we are getting ready for Next Steam Fest.

[h2]What was added?[/h2]
[list]
[*]New level that is called Sea Of Simulation
[*]New enemies
[*]Another attack to acquire
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417373/05c4a41406c9f1da0952e31493fb7abdb6db351a.png[/img]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Controller support
[*]Keyboard keys remapping
[*]Gamma adjustable
[*]Controller sensitivity adjustable
[*]Performance boost
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417373/051e8f88fe1459206399a6bd3eaaa2e2bbe20c31.png[/img]

Full version is planned to be released this year soon after Steam Fest that will take place Feb05. Wish you all great fest and a lot of fun! ;)
